messages.content: "你能幫我在圖書館找一本書嗎？我正在紐約尋找一本名為《梅岡城故事》的書，我想知道它現在是否可借用。此外，我對「小說」這個類型很感興趣。找到後，你能為我預訂嗎？書號是「123ABC」，分館號是「XYZ789」。我計劃在「2022-12-31」前歸還。"

function.name: library_search_book
function.description: Searches for a book in the library within the specified city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book_name.description: The name of the book to search for.

availability.description: If true, search for available copies. If false or omitted, search for any copy regardless of availability. Default false

genre.description: The genre of the book to filter search (optional).

function.name: library_reserve_book
function.description: Reserves a book in the library if available. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

book_id.description: The id of the book to reserve.

branch_id.description: The id of the library branch to reserve from.

return_date.description: The date the book is to be returned (optional).

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to find whether the book "梅岡城故事" is currently available and then reserve it.

We have two steps:

1) Search for the book with title "梅冈城故事", city "纽约". They want to know if it's available now. So we need to call `library_search_book` with parameters:
   - book_name="梅岡城故事"
   - city="New York" (NY)
   - availability=true? Actually they ask "I want to know if it's currently borrowable." That means check availability. So set availability:true.
   - genre maybe "小说"? But not necessary; but can include as optional param. We might specify genre:"novel".

But note: The tool expects English names? It says "the city to search within." Provide "New York" presumably. Book name "梅岡城故事" may be Chinese characters. Should pass exactly.

So first step: call library_search_book(book_name="梅岡城故事", city="New York", availability=True). Optionally add genre="Novel".

Then after retrieving results, see if there's an entry with ID "123ABC" at branch "XYZ789". Then proceed to reservation using library_reserve_book(book_id="123ABC", branch_id="XYZ789", return_date="2022-12-31").

Thus we will do sequential calls. We'll start with searching.
